purpose: Define a single non-colliding semantic value-ID namespace for parameters, locals, typed constants and instruction results without reusing the legacy numeric-token stream as if it were semantic SSA.

semantic_id_layout.dynamic_allocation: monotonic physical-slot allocation; semantic IDs may contain reserved extension holes for wide literals

constant_representation.reason: Repeated immutable constants, especially fixed-array zero initializers, must not consume one semantic value record per lexical occurrence.

wide_literal.verifier_requirement: no operand/result/terminator/call argument may reference an extension-only slot

parameter_value.type_and_owner: must agree with packed parameter metadata

local_value.type_and_owner: must agree with packed local metadata
local_value.note: A later store changes the value flowing through instructions; it does not create a new local identity. Instruction-result/source value IDs preserve def-use separately.

instruction_result.owner: derived/verified against defining instruction block owner
instruction_result.allocation: only for instructions whose semantic result is consumed or returned under the bootstrap lowering contract

capacity_rules: Do not use lexical numeric-token count as semantic value count.
Do not assume static zero-initializer count is free headroom.
Intern typed immutable constants before capacity calculation.
Count only semantically materialized instruction results, but prove every use has exactly one valid definition.
Parameter/local fixed domains must never collide with dynamic constants/results.
If exact semantic records plus extension slots exceed 1460, route to a measured bank-expansion design rather than truncate.
required_preflight_measurements: native parameter_count from PASS local candidate
native local_record_count from PASS local candidate
exact maximum semantic value ID/physical slot
exact use-site inventory for operands, calls and terminators
verifier_requirements: parameter IDs [0,parameter_count) are populated and agree with parameter records
unused reserved parameter IDs are never referenced
local IDs start at 64 and agree with local records
dynamic allocation begins after local identities
every constant has a valid primitive type
wide constants own exactly one following extension slot and preserve the raw signed i64 payload
extension-only slots are never used as semantic IDs
instruction-result values reference valid defining instructions
all use sites reference defined header semantic IDs
value owner/type compatibility is checked at each use
no namespace collision, truncation or out-of-range reference
prohibited_shortcuts: reinterpret legacy ir_value_records as semantic IDs without rebuild
raw-source reread by emitter to recover literal values or variable identities
one semantic value per lexical zero initializer occurrence
truncate large literals into packed metadata
allocate arbitrary larger value arrays before exact measurement
